facts.text: Governors Village earned the title “Community of the Year” in 2009 from the North Carolina Chapter of the Community Associations Institute.
The name Governors Village evokes a planned, community‑oriented development, suggesting an orderly, upscale residential area in North Carolina’s Piedmont region.
Across the street from Governors Village lies Governors Club, a 1,600‑acre gated community featuring a 27‑hole Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course.
Within the community, residents enjoy numerous parks, sidewalks, walking trails, and a small lake that serve as local gathering spots.
Just a few miles from Governors Village, Jordan Lake offers a large recreation lake popular for boating, fishing, and family outings.
In 2012, The Commons @ Governors Village opened, adding retail space, a realty office, an independent pharmacy, and a construction firm to the area’s commercial mix.
